terminals.name: django
terminals.command: set -a; source .cursor/dev.env; set +a; exec poetry run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
terminals.description: Django REST API dev server on :8000 (health: /health/, readiness: /ready/, docs: /api/docs/).

terminals.name: celery
terminals.command: set -a; source .cursor/dev.env; set +a; exec poetry run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2
terminals.description: Celery worker for background tasks (hold expiry sweep, payment timeouts, ticket emails).
